channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: La Jolla Country Day grad Kelsey Plum at Team USA training camp for World Cup qualifying
item.description: “My objective is to win everything,” Plum said. “When you put on a USA Basketball uniform, you’re representing a lot more than yourself.”

item.title: Alexander Butterfield, La Jolla resident who disclosed Watergate tapes, dies at 99
item.description: Butterfield said he believed that Nixon’s successor, President Gerald Ford, fired him as FAA administrator in 1975 as part of an agreement.

item.title: American Red Cross seeking blood donations after severe storms across country
item.description: Those who come to give blood, platelets, or plasma this month will receive a $15 Amazon Gift Card by email.

item.title: El Pueblo moving into former Jack in the Box spot on Pearl Street
item.description: The new location will join other established restaurants along a two-block stretch, including Taco Stand, La Corriente, and El Pescador.

item.title: TripAdvisor names La Jolla Cove best beach in United States
item.description: Santa Monica State Beach, the only other California site in the top 10, was noted for its boardwalk and surfing opportunities.

item.title: If SDSU is to shake off regular-season doldrums heading into March Madness, rebounds are key
item.description: After an up-and-down regular season, SDSU still finds itself seeded second as the conference tournament begins. The Aztecs play Thursday.

item.title: Planned Parenthood warns of ‘silent’ STI crisis despite declining San Diego County rates
item.description: Following an announcement by the county office of Health and Human Services that the rate of sexually transmitted infections has dropped around the county, Planned Parenthood of the Pacific Southwest said Monday there could be a "silent crisis" of unreported STIs.

item.title: County CFO Joan Bracci to also serve as assistant chief administrative officer
item.description: San Diego County leaders Monday appointed Chief Financial Officer Joan Bracci to also serve as the county's assistant chief administrative officer following the upcoming departure of Assistant CAO Caroline Smith.

item.title: Record-breaking March heat possible this week in San Diego County
item.description: Cooler weather will linger across San Diego County through Tuesday before a dramatic warm-up later in the week that could bring record-breaking March heat, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Uber adds option for women riders to match with women drivers in safety push
item.description: Uber launched a feature Monday to allow both women riders and drivers across the U.S. to be matched with other women for trips, expanding a pilot program aimed at addressing concerns about the safety of its ride-hailing platform.
